title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 8: Emiko Furukawa
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．８ ～古川恵美子～
overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 8: Furukawa Emiko is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Emiko Furukawa. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.
